verdicts.evidence: Dominion Energy's Bath County Power Station recreation area (Back Creek), open to the general public April-October, FCFS; Dominion's page mentions camping permits and fees but gives no amount; The Dyrt's "from $10" is an aggregator figure; not on RV Life.
flags: public-access utility land with nothing to book: the web-presence rule's premise does not hold (flag, not auto-remove)

decisions: AWH 2026-10-11: drop the 4 inclusion failures; drop Gigglin' Grizzly, Cedar Valley and Franklin; keep Gary's and Bath County; drop Fort Steele and Scott's (posted rates over the gate) and Red Pine Lodge.
